standard_prerequisites.name: Desingularization along a strictly standard element
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the factorization A tensor_R D -> B -> Lambda with aB inside H_{B/D}.

standard_prerequisites.name: Strictly standard elements survive base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps pi strictly standard in A tensor_R D over D.

standard_prerequisites.name: Annihilators commute with flat base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the annihilator quotient vanishes after flat localization, so a escapes every flat prime.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compositions of smooth maps are smooth
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the second inclusion H_{D/R}B inside H_{B/R}.

core_obligations: Apply the desingularization lemma to D -> A tensor_R D -> Lambda and the image of pi; by the base-change lemma pi is strictly standard in A tensor_R D over D, and the map of hypothesis (2) provides the mod-pi^4 section.
The desingularization lemma yields A tensor_R D -> B -> Lambda with B finitely presented and aB inside H_{B/D} for a = Ann_D(Ann_D(pi^2)/Ann_D(pi)).

At any prime q of D with D_q flat over R, the annihilator quotient Ann(pi^2)/Ann(pi) pulls back to zero by flat base change of annihilators and the hypothesis Ann_R(pi) = Ann_R(pi^2); finiteness of the quotient module makes its annihilator localize, so a is not contained in q.
Hence D -> B is smooth at every prime over a flat prime of D, which gives H_{D/R}B inside H_{B/D}; composing smooth maps gives H_{D/R}B inside H_{B/R}.
proof_roadmap: Desingularization application; base change of strict standardness; annihilator transport along flat primes; two H-ideal inclusions.
difficulty_reason: A four-step argument; the substance is the flat-base-change annihilator computation that localizes the singular ideal.
